title: Git Optimizer local configuration
description: Bounded repository access, Git execution, and result-shaping settings for the local package profile.

GIT_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Comma- or semicolon-separated absolute directories that may contain repositories.

GIT_LOCAL_PATHS_ENABLED.description: Use the launch directory as the implicit root when no explicit roots are supplied.

GIT_EXECUTABLE.description: Absolute path to a trusted Git 2.34 or newer executable.

GIT_TRUST_REPOSITORY_OWNERSHIP.description: Opt into safe.directory=* for repositories deliberately exposed by another owner.

GIT_EXTRA_IGNORED_BASENAMES.description: Comma-separated additional basenames to filter from review output.

GIT_EXTRA_IGNORED_DIRECTORIES.description: Comma-separated additional directory names to filter from review output.
